press_references.value: Fuze and Halborn partner to modernize the way global institutions launch secure digital asset services

partnership_announcements.description: Fuze and Halborn formed a strategic partnership to combine Fuze’s regulated digital-asset infrastructure with Halborn’s cybersecurity expertise, helping banks and financial institutions launch secure, compliant digital-asset services and co-develop frameworks, policies, and go‑to‑market initiatives.

press_references.value: Miden and Fuze sign MoU to bring private, regulated digital assets infrastructure to mainstream banking

partnership_announcements.description: Fuze and Miden signed a memorandum of understanding for a strategic partnership to co-develop privacy-preserving, regulated digital asset infrastructure for financial institutions across the Middle East, Africa, and other emerging markets.

press_references.value: Central Bank of Jordan onboards Fuze to regulatory sandbox, marking expansion to the Kingdom

partnership_announcements.description: Fuze announced a new strategic collaboration with the Central Bank of Jordan, being onboarded to the JoRegBox regulatory sandbox to develop compliant digital asset infrastructure with Jordanian banks and fintechs.

press_references.value: Fuze enhances compliance through new exaforce AI partnership

partnership_announcements.description: Fuze announced a new partnership with Exaforce to embed AI-driven MDR and security operations into its stablecoin platform, enhancing regulatory compliance and threat detection across MENA.

press_references.value: UAE’s Fuze signs MoU with Oman’s Mamun to facilitate trade finance via stablecoins

partnership_announcements.description: Fuze and Mamun have announced a strategic partnership to facilitate Sharia-compliant trade finance using stablecoins, aiming to bridge digital asset infrastructure with traditional private credit markets in the MENA region.

press_references.value: Fuze Secures UAE Central Bank License to Power Next-Gen Payments

partnership_announcements.description: Fuze has secured a Retail Payment Services and Card Schemes license from the Central Bank of the UAE, allowing it to offer AI-driven, compliant digital payment infrastructure across the MENA region. This partnership supports the UAE Digital Economy Strategy and marks a significant milestone for Fuze.

press_references.value: Fuze Partners with Fils to Launch the First Digital Asset Sustainability Solution in the Region

partnership_announcements.description: Fuze and Fils partner to launch a sustainable digital asset solution, integrating blockchain for transparency and carbon footprint offsetting.

about_short_description.short_description: Fuze is a digital assets infrastructure startup that specializes in providing payments and crypto solutions for businesses.

product.name: Digital Assets as a Service
product.description: APIs that enable businesses to embed crypto trading, custody, lending, and loyalty features into their applications while managing infrastructure, liquidity, compliance, and security.

product.name: Stablecoin Infrastructure
product.description: A platform to manage stablecoin orchestration, enabling large crypto orders, real-time settlements, and seamless on-ramp and off-ramp solutions across 100+ tokens.

product.name: Payments
product.description: A service to accept and disburse payments globally with real-time settlement, fraud protection, and regulatory compliance.

product.name: OTC (Over-the-Counter) Trading
product.description: A 24/7 platform for executing large crypto orders with access to 100+ tokens, real-time settlements, and integrated on-ramp and off-ramp solutions.

product.name: Onramp / Offramp
product.description: Services that facilitate cross-border fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-fiat conversions with real-time settlements and access to 100+ tokens.

product.name: AI Tools
product.description: AI-powered tools to support cross-border fiat-crypto conversions and large crypto order executions with real-time settlements and compliance.
